images.alt: A desktop monitor showing the IDEA AI Wiki in dark mode: a sidebar of facility-management tools, wiki categories such as Electrical and HVAC, and a list of maintenance guides with their sharing status.

Three phones showing the IDEA Mapping app: selecting assets on a building floor plan to geofence, a city map with clustered pins for people, assets and locations, and the map in Emergency mode with first-aid points and shelters.
A laptop showing Colleague.AI's Create Assessment form, with assessment details, rubric and answer-key settings, next to a phone showing the assistant's "How can I help you today?" home screen.

A desktop showing the City of Seattle permit dashboard with an AI estimate of review time (78 days) broken into review stages, and a laptop showing an AI review report flagging issues in a residential reroofing permit application.

Three phones showing the smart parking concept in Google Maps: parking filters for price, type and time limit, a driving route across Seattle with parking options, and a camera view reading a street-cleaning no-parking sign.
A laptop showing Planet Party Time gameplay: cartoon characters racing around a running track with hurdles and springboards, a countdown timer and an onboarding tip about using the springboard.
